title: LORA Tunnel SD configuration, schema 1
description: Save as /lora-tunnel/config.json on SD. Current firmware accepts a 16 KiB file and fixed 16 KiB JSON arena; additional fields are retained but not necessarily implemented.

enabled.description: Fresh installations keep LoRa off until an explicit region selection. Wardriver and Recon only receive. Dedicated Messages mode requires a separate runtime TX confirmation; this saved field never authorizes transmission.

selection_complete.description: An explicit Skip saves true with region UNSET, completing first setup while leaving LoRa disabled. Supported named regions and valid legacy US configurations also count as a completed choice.

region.description: Omitted on legacy schema-1 files: enabled or explicit-frequency configs retain previous US settings; a bare disabled config remains UNSET. 433/470 MHz profiles require other hardware. Firmware validates occupied bandwidth against the target: Heltec 863-928 MHz or Cardputer U214 868-923 MHz.

name.description: Firmware limit is 39 UTF-8 bytes, not arbitrary Unicode characters.

frequency_mhz.description: UNSET uses zero. Omitted values derive from the named preset/slot, or LongFast for older configurations. Explicit raw radio fields must agree with a named preset; use CUSTOM for literal settings. Firmware requires the full occupied bandwidth to fit the region and target hardware. Legacy configs without region remain limited to the US 902-928 MHz band.

meshtastic_preset.description: Named receive modem preset, with frequency derived from region and slot. LONG_TURBO is 500 kHz/SF11/CR4/8; a region too narrow for a preset rejects it without silently retuning. CUSTOM preserves literal raw radio fields. Older custom files without this field are inferred as CUSTOM. Firmware validates consistency with any explicit raw fields.

meshtastic_slot.description: Zero chooses the named preset's default-channel slot; positive values are one-based slots. Firmware rejects slots exceeding the region/preset slot count. CUSTOM only accepts zero. LongTurbo defaults to slot 14 in US and ANZ; slot 20 is the LongFast default in those regions.

mode.description: Wardriver LoRa reception mode. Combined alternates one selected Meshtastic profile and one selected MeshCore profile; it does not receive both simultaneously.

dwell_ms.description: Minimum listen interval per profile in combined mode. In-progress packet handling can extend this interval; the opposite profile is not monitored during it.

meshcore_profile.description: AUTO chooses the first available preset for the selected region. Supported explicit names are listed in docs/COMBINED_MESH.md. Active MeshCore/combined mode requires a preset belonging to the region. The target hardware band is validated separately.

decode_public.description: Attempt the published Meshtastic default AES-CTR key and MeshCore Public group key. Disabling this does not remove explicitly configured keys for either protocol or disable public MeshCore advert parsing.

meshtastic_keys.description: Private local channel keys. These are not WiGLE/WDGWars credentials. The firmware computes the eight-bit channel hash from each exact channel name and key. Keys never belong in observation logs or published configuration.

meshcore_keys.description: Private MeshCore group keys, separate from Meshtastic and upload credentials. The group hash is the first byte of SHA256 of the original 16-byte or 32-byte key; its local descriptive name does not affect reception. Keys never belong in observation logs or published configuration.

messaging.description: Settings for the development candidate's separate Messages mode. Capture must be stopped and saved. Public/default channel keys are selected by blank strings. No saved or imported setting can enable transmission; TX requires explicit confirmation in each runtime session.

name.description: 1-31 printable ASCII bytes, excluding colon. This is a display name, not an authenticated identity.

meshtastic_channel.description: Exact case-sensitive printable ASCII channel name. Blank selects AUTO, using the current preset's default channel name. A channel name does not change the radio preset or frequency slot.

meshtastic_key_hex.description: Blank selects the published Meshtastic default channel key; it does not mean plaintext. Otherwise supply an expanded 16-byte or 32-byte AES key as 32 or 64 hexadecimal digits.

meshcore_key_hex.description: Blank selects the published MeshCore Public group key. Otherwise supply an expanded 16-byte or 32-byte group key as 32 or 64 hexadecimal digits.

hop_limit.description: Meshtastic hop limit; does not configure MeshCore routing.

enabled.description: Do not persist mode activation. Firmware ignores this imported flag and starts with Messages stopped.

tx_enabled.description: Do not persist transmit permission. Firmware ignores this imported flag; explicit runtime TX confirmation is always required.

categories.description: Omitted means every category; an empty list disables all Recon categories. These are evidence categories, not authenticated device identities.

buttons_enabled.description: Enable the physical-button shortcuts; Cardputer keyboard and Heltec touchscreen controls remain available.

uploads.description: Explicit opt-in per service. Only closed Wardriver sessions are eligible while capture is stopped and configured home Wi-Fi is available. Never automatically pauses capture.

credentials.description: Private SD plaintext settings, masked in UI. Automatic sending requires the corresponding uploads switch. Never include real values in examples/logs/source control.

messaging_key.description: Private SD plaintext setting, masked in the editor. Blank resets to the protocol's public default key. Never include configured keys in published examples or source packages.

name.description: Exact channel name, case-sensitive; firmware limit is 39 UTF-8 bytes. A modem preset name is not necessarily the channel name.

key_hex.description: Expanded 16-byte or 32-byte AES key as hexadecimal. Empty string explicitly selects plaintext for this named channel. Base64 shortcuts such as AQ== are not accepted here; decode_public already covers the ordinary published default key.

name.description: Local descriptive label; firmware limit is 39 UTF-8 bytes. It is not included in the MeshCore group hash and does not identify a sender.

key_hex.description: Expanded 16-byte or 32-byte MeshCore group key as hexadecimal. Empty/plaintext and Base64 shortcuts are not accepted. decode_public already covers the published Public group key.

credential.description: Firmware capacity is 127 UTF-8 bytes plus NUL, not 127 arbitrary Unicode characters. Empty string means unconfigured.
